Product Features

  • The sofa is made of coarsely ribbed corduroy fabric and combines a classic-retro look with a soft, skin-friendly feel. This material is not only robust and durable, but also fits seamlessly into various furnishing styles - from modern minimalist to rural casual. The firm, stable fibre structure ensures a warm and secure feeling of sitting and lying down, creating relaxing moments of relaxation.
  • Flexible DIY combination system: The compact sofa offers complete freedom in design! You can combine the modules according to your wishes and the size of the room - whether as a single sofa, loveseat or large seating group. Perfect for small apartments or for those who like to remodel their furnishings regularly without sacrificing comfort.
  • Practical side compartments and cup holders: The integrated large side compartments offer enough space for TV remote control, books, magazines or mobile phones - all within reach. The included cup holders prevent drinks from accidentally tipping over, ideal for movie nights or relaxation times without needing extra tables.
  • High-density foam cushion with spring elements: Inside the sofa there is high-density foam cushion which, together with built-in spring elements, ensures optimal rebound. The seat is soft but stable, not too soft and not too hard - perfect for long periods of sitting or naps. It reduces fatigue of the spine and ensures long-lasting comfort.
  • Compact design with versatile use: As a compact sofa, it is space-saving, yet spacious. It is suitable for any room – living room, guest room, study, even children's room. Whether as a main seat, guest sofa or additional seating area for parties - it adapts to every situation and makes optimal use of the space.
  • Three thick cushions included: The sofa comes with three thick, soft cushions that are made of high-quality filling material. They can be used as a headrest, back support, or knee pillow for extra comfort. The neutral colors match the thick flannel fabric and are easy to combine with other decorations.
  • with a robust internal structure. The spring elements not only provide rebound, but also strengthen the stability of the sofa. The thick flannel material is abrasion-resistant and easy to clean - simply clean with a vacuum cleaner or wipe with a damp cloth for light soiling.
  • Classic and timeless design: The sofa combines classic thick flannel design with modern features. The simple, more elegant shape and neutral color options make it timeless and versatile. It doesn't get outdated quickly and can give your décor a warm, cosy feel for years to come – a long-term investment for your home.
